products.name: Pot

products.name: Committed plan
products.note: A pot with agreed terms earns a personal rate while the plan holds; exit is free (Sam's house deposit: 5.1%).

products.name: Investment portfolio
products.note: Floor-protected allocation; guidance never regulated advice; growth illustrated at 5%/yr.

products.name: HSBC Points
products.rule: Earned for openness and healthy habits — never for spending, balances, engagement volume or trading (FCA boundary, Data/04 §8.5).

products.name: Card cashback
products.rule: A feature of the card, earned on card spending, shown as a fact and never promoted by the AI (Data/04 §8.5).

products.name: Premier
products.rule: Status follows the relationship; points never buy it (Data/04 §6.9).
